findings.description: The cycle-detection guard was removed from the __cause__ chain walk, so a cyclic cause chain now makes the while loop run forever.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception whose __cause__ chain loops back on itself, such as e.__cause__ = e, or e1.__cause__ = e2 with e2.__cause__ = e1, raised from a retried function. Mechanism: the loop only stops when exc becomes None, and with a cycle it never does, so the retry predicate never returns. Impact: the retrying call hangs indefinitely instead of deciding whether to retry. Such cycles need explicit manual assignment, so the trigger is uncommon.
